lines: Fine. I was getting tired of being angry anyway.
Fine. I'll set this down before it gets heavier.
I can stop the fight. I would like that more than winning it.
Fine. I can let this cool, but do not mistake calm for forgetting.
That helps. Keep your hands peaceful and we may still end this properly.
I accept. The angry part of me may take another minute.
Fine. Nobody needs another bruise to make this official.
That settles the payment. The memory can sort itself out later.
Alright. I am lowering my guard, but not dropping my sense.
We can end this here. Here is a very good place to end things.
I will take it and let the village breathe normally again.
Fine. I prefer emeralds on the ground to teeth on the ground.
That is enough. Step back while I remember how peace stands.
I agree. Let us both walk away in different useful directions.
The offer is fair, and I am too tired to stay furious for decoration.
We are settled. Do not poke the settlement to see if it moves.
Alright. My fists can go back to being ordinary hands.
I accept your terms. Keep your next idea gentle.
Fine. The fight is over before either of us becomes more ridiculous.
That will do. Leave quietly and let quiet remain.
I counted, then forgot, then counted again. It should be {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
That's short of the full repair. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Not enough. If you want peace, bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and mean it.
I may lose count sometimes, but even I can see that is not {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The offer needs {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not a hopeful little pile.
Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. I wrote the number on my hand this time.
You are missing part of the payment. The whole part is important.
I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, and wishing does not make the pile taller.
I counted twice and asked someone better at counting. It is still {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This does not cover the harm. Bring the full amount.
Come back with {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Then we can both stop counting.
You cannot bargain with the empty space beside those emeralds.
The price is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. My fingers agree.
This ends when all {emerald_cost} {emeralds} are here.
The pile is too small. I checked from two angles.
I am not lowering the cost because your pockets made a sad sound.
The offer is incomplete. It needs the rest of its emeralds.
You know the amount now. Return with {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Short payment does not mend the full harm.
I will wait for the proper {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Waiting is free.
No. Some damage has to cool before payment matters.
No. Keep {payment_items}. Trust is not ready to trade.
No payment matters while the danger is still standing here.
Put {payment_items} away. My hands are not calm enough to bargain.
You are trying to pay for damage that is still happening.
I will not take {payment_items} and pretend my knees stopped shaking.
Not now. Give the village room before you offer anything.
I need safety first. We can count debts after everyone can breathe.
Keep {payment_items}. Taking them would make this look more settled than it is.
I am not putting a price on trust while you are still breaking it.
Step back. Distance is the only payment I want right now.
The village is still bracing when you move. That means no deal.
You cannot buy calm while people are hiding from you.
Stop making new harm before you offer to pay for the old harm.
I do not want {payment_items}. I want the doors to feel safe again.
No. The threat must end before the counting begins.
I cannot trust an offer from someone I still cannot turn my back on.
I know you brought {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. I am still not accepting them.
Put the weapon away first. I will not discuss peace with steel in my face.
No bargain today. Take {payment_items} and go.
